title: Andhra Pradesh Cabinet Approves PPP Policy and Ease of Doing Business Act

blocks.content: The Andhra Pradesh Cabinet, chaired by Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu in Amaravati on 6 August 2026, approved the draft Andhra Pradesh Public-Private Partnership (PPP) Policy-2026 and the draft Andhra Pradesh Omnibus (Ease of Doing Business) Act, 2026. The Cabinet also cleared measures on pedestrian safety, quantum infrastructure, aquaculture subsidy, and the withdrawal of the Andhra Pradesh Disha Bill, 2019.

items: Viability Gap Funding is a government support mechanism for infrastructure projects that are economically justified but not fully financially viable.
Public-Private Partnership is a model used in sectors such as ports, roads, healthcare, education, and energy.
The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita are part of India’s new criminal law regime.
Amaravati is the capital region of Andhra Pradesh and the site of the Quantum Valley Twin Towers project.
